board: Sensirion SEN54-SDN-T on the Adafruit SEN54 or SEN55 Adapter Breakout - STEMMA QT / Qwiic (product 5964), header VIN, GND, SCL, SDA
reason: Check passed first run on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, circuit board, footprint). Modelled per SEN5x datasheet section 6: 0x0021 start, 0x0202 data-ready, 0x03C4 read (8 words, uint16 PM/10, int16 RH/100, T/200, VOC/10, Sensirion CRC each); the NOx word is a constant 0x7FFF (unknown), as the SEN54 has no NOx sensor.
breakoutPinoutSource: Adafruit board file (github.com/adafruit/Adafruit-SEN5x-Adapter-Breakout-PCB): JP1 pad 1 VCC, 2 GND, 3 SCL, 4 SDA; Adafruit learn guide pinouts page (Vin, GND, SCL, SDA, 10K pull-ups)
